channel.description: Aggregated rainfall, thunderstorm, and special forecasts from PAGASA MINPRSD

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 30 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 30 #MINPRSD
Issued at 08:00 AM 28 August 2026

Light to Moderate to Occasionally Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #DinagatIslands, #Camiguin, #ZamboangaCity, #LanaoDelNorte(Baroy, SultanNagaDimaporo), #MisamisOccidental(Bonifacio, TangubCity, OzamisCity), #ZamboangaDelSur(Labangan, PagadianCity, Dumalinao, SanPablo, Aurora, Tambulig, Tukuran, Dinas), #SurigaoDelNorte(SurigaoCity, TaganaAn, Placer, Bacuag and Sison) within the next 1-2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #LanaoDelNorte(Kapatagan and Lala) which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 29 #MINPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 29 #MINPRSD
Issued at 06:00 AM 28 August 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #AgusanDelNorte(Santiago, Tubay, CityOfCabadbaran, Kitcharao, Jabonga, Magallanes, ButuanCity, Carmen, Nasipit, Buenavista), #SurigaoDelNorte, #Camiguin, #ZamboangaSibugay(Payao, Tungawan, Malangas, Imelda, RosellerLim, Buug, Siay, Ipil, Diplahan, Titay, Naga, Kabasalan, Alicia), #ZamboangaDelSur, #TawiTawi(Sitangkai, Sibutu, Simunul, SapaSapa, Bongao, PanglimaSugala, Tandubas, Languyan, SouthUbian, TurtleIslands), #LanaoDelNorte, #DinagatIslands, #MisamisOriental, #MisamisOccidental, #ZamboangaDelNorte(Sibuco, Sirawai), #Basilan, #Sulu(Pangutaran and HadjiPanglimaTahil) within the next 1-2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #ZamboangaSibugay(Talusan, Olutanga, Mabuhay), #AgusanDelNorte(RemediosT.Romualdez) and #ZamboangaCity which may persist within 1-2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
